name: SUIT VIOLENCE DEMO
summary:
It starts with a suit. What happens next is up to you.

SUIT VIOLENCE DEMO offers a small taste of the world we’re building: your first opportunity to experience its style, get familiar with its equipment and discover its possibilities in virtual reality.

Step into the dressing room, choose your outfit and open the armory. Handle weapons, practice your aim and experiment with close-quarters combat. Take your time, repeat each challenge and find your own way of doing things.
